title: Implement --category flag — filter dashboard to single category
description: When --category <name> is provided, filter all dashboard stats to only tasks matching that category. Show an error for unrecognized category names.
acceptanceCriteria: rocket status --category ui-ux shows only ui-ux tasks in progress sections
Unknown category name prints a helpful error and exits non-zero
Category filter applies to the full dashboard and incomplete listing

steps.description: Apply category filter to tasks before computing stats
steps.details: In statusCommand: if (options.category) { const allCategories = [...new Set(allTasks.map(t => t.category))]; if (!allCategories.includes(options.category)) { console.error(`Unknown category: ${options.category}. Valid: ${allCategories.join(', ')}`); process.exit(1) }; tasks = tasks.filter(t => t.category === options.category) }
Run `npm run dev -- status --category config` in a project with mixed categories. Verify only config tasks appear in the output.
